holiday_calendars_subdivision_ck.name: holiday_calendars_subdivision_ck
holiday_calendars_subdivision_ck.value: "holiday_calendars"."subdivision" is null or length("holiday_calendars"."subdivision") between 2 and 20

accounts_synced_provider_ck.name: accounts_synced_provider_ck
accounts_synced_provider_ck.value: "accounts"."origin" = 'manual' or ("accounts"."provider" is not null and "accounts"."provider_account_id" is not null)

budget_limits_scope_ck.name: budget_limits_scope_ck
budget_limits_scope_ck.value: "budget_limits"."category_id" is not null or "budget_limits"."account_id" is not null

fund_operations_quarter_ck.name: fund_operations_quarter_ck
fund_operations_quarter_ck.value: ("fund_operations"."competence_year" is null) = ("fund_operations"."competence_quarter" is null) and ("fund_operations"."competence_quarter" is null or "fund_operations"."competence_quarter" between 1 and 4)

pension_rules_pct_ck.name: pension_rules_pct_ck
pension_rules_pct_ck.value: coalesce("pension_rules"."worker_pct", 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce("pension_rules"."employer_pct", 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce("pension_rules"."tfr_pct", 0) between 0 and 100

document_evidence_bbox_ck.name: document_evidence_bbox_ck
document_evidence_bbox_ck.value: "document_evidence"."bbox" is null or (cardinality("document_evidence"."bbox") = 4 and "document_evidence"."page" is not null)

payslips_period_ck.name: payslips_period_ck
payslips_period_ck.value: "payslips"."period" is null or (extract(day from "payslips"."period") = 1 and extract(year from "payslips"."period") = "payslips"."year")

payslips_period_type_ck.name: payslips_period_type_ck
payslips_period_type_ck.value: ("payslips"."type" <> 'ordinary' or "payslips"."period" is not null) and ("payslips"."type" not in ('thirteenth', 'fourteenth') or "payslips"."period" is null)

pocket_movements_sign_ck.name: pocket_movements_sign_ck
pocket_movements_sign_ck.value: case "pocket_movements"."kind" when 'accrual' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" > 0 when 'deposit' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" > 0 when 'withdrawal' then "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" < 0 else "pocket_movements"."amount_cents" <> 0 end

generated.as: case when parent_id is null then null else true end
